# Site header (web)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`public-site`](../../flows/public-site/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Owns the `SiteHeader` query (`SITE_HEADER_QUERY`, the one root field `header`, with `appName`, `navs` and their `subNavs`, no `requiresRole`: every entry shows to every visitor; the CV link is a `navs` entry, not built in) and its loader for `components/layouts/SiteHeader.tsx` and the layout metadata ([public-site flow](../../flows/public-site/FLOW.md), PS-1). It fails on its own: `null` never affects the sign-in or page queries.

## Techniques

`SiteHeader.graphql.ts` is client-safe; `SiteHeader.server.ts` is `server-only` and calls `executeGraphql` with the mock key `site-header`. The account menu text (`openCms`, `signedInAs`, `signOutFailed`) comes from the sign-in query, not from here. `loadSiteHeader` keeps one result per request (ADR 0023): React `cache` outside, and inside it a module-level `WeakMap` keyed on the request's `await headers()` object holds the promise, so a 404 (which renders the layout twice) reads the header once and the mock or failure is reused; a new request has a new headers object, so nothing is shared across requests. It returns `null` when the read failed or the root field answered null (`executeGraphql` logged it; no second line). Same split as `features/status`.

A sub list is state-driven in `SiteNav` `NavItem` (`aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` on the entry): it opens on hover, on focus entering the entry and on a click or tap, and closes on Escape (focus returns to the entry), on focus or the pointer leaving, and on a pointer-down outside. An entry with sub entries and no safe link is `NavLabel`, a `button`. On a touch pointer the first tap on a linked entry opens its list without following the link; the second follows it; a mouse or keyboard click follows at once.

`MobileNavDrawer` (`components/layouts`, PS-6) is the menu button and the right side panel (form-commons `Dialog`) with the same entries: one list through `isNavEntryShown` and `NavLink` (both exported by `SiteNav`), sub entries always listed and indented, a link-less parent a plain heading. It closes on a link click, a `usePathname` change and the `DESKTOP_NAV_MEDIA_QUERY` (equal to Tailwind `md`) matching; the button and close names are `MOBILE_NAV_TEXT` (built-in, WEB-3). `SiteHeader` mounts it below `md` (wrapper `md:hidden`) and `SiteNav` from `md` up (wrapper `hidden md:flex`), so exactly one is in the accessibility tree at every width; both take the `SiteHeader` answer already loaded, and with no header text neither is mounted. The brand truncates (`min-w-0 truncate`) so the bar does not overflow at 320 px.

## Technologies

React (`cache`); `next/headers`; `graphql` (dev, in specs).

## Entry points

`loadSiteHeader`, `SITE_HEADER_QUERY` (server file), the types (`SiteHeader.graphql.ts`).

## Where to change what

A new entry kind: change `SiteNav.tsx` once (`isNavEntryShown`, `NavLink`); the drawer follows. A new header text: add it to `SITE_HEADER_QUERY`, the type and `SiteHeader.mock.ts` together; `SiteHeader.graphql.test.ts` fails when they differ. Keep the D18 limits. The header has no role filter (`SiteNav` `isNavEntryShown` decides by title and safe link); the WEB-7 role rule (`useCanSee`) comes back in `NavItem` with the later role feature.
